sentences.en: The turnover at my company is really speeding up lately.
sentences.zh: 最近我公司的营业额真的在加速增长。

sentences.en: The new model is featured by higher power and speed.
sentences.zh: 新款车型以更高的功率和速度为卖点。

sentences.en: The new airplane flies at twice the speed of sound.
sentences.zh: 这架新飞机的速度是音速的两倍。
